title: fix(plugin-hono-server): a Hono door's 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE carries currentVersion (#23531)
body:
Part of #23531
Clause-②: no

This lands the card's `currentVersion` half. Its `currentRecord` half stays on the card, ordered after #23586 (patch round 1, the seat's review `6182753773`).

## What this does

A stale `If-Match` on `PATCH` or `DELETE /data/:object/:id` is refused by the protocol with `ConcurrentUpdateError` (`409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE`). `RestServer` answers it with the server's `currentVersion` (and `currentRecord`). Both Hono doors answered it with `code` and `message` only: `@objectstack/hono`'s `createHonoApp` (its `dispatch()` catch-all, through `thrownJson`) and a route mounted on `HonoHttpServer` (`wrap()`, and the transport `onError` seam). All three paths render through one function, `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` in `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`. That function forwarded only the `details` that the thrown-error resolver derives, and it never reads the two fields, because they are own properties of the error.

`declaredEnvelopeForThrow` now asks one helper beside it, `declaredConflictContext`. For a `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE`, that helper reads the conflict's context off `structuredCodeAnswer` (`@objectstack/types`, already exported). That is the arm `RestServer`'s `mapDataError` answers this conflict through. Everything the arm's body carries is forwarded except three keys:
- its own sentence and code, which the envelope already carries as `message` and `code`;
- `currentRecord`, which is held (next section).

So:

- ⛔ no third spelling of the conflict body. The one field the Hono package names is the one it holds back, and it names it only to hold it. Everything else appears only when the producer stated it, by the REST arm's own rule;
- the arm must agree with the envelope already decided (same status, same code), so it can only add context and never changes the answer;
- only `CONCURRENT_UPDATE` is taken, per the card's scope ruling. Other structured arms are listed under Acceptance notes.

**Where it lands:** `error.details`. On the wrapped envelope (`{ success, error }`) that is the declared context slot (`ApiErrorSchema.details`), and it is where `@objectstack/client` reads a wrapped body's context (`error.details = errorBody.details ?? errorBody.error.details ?? errorBody`). That is what objectui's `normaliseClientError` reads `currentVersion` from. The REST door's flat body has no envelope, so it carries the field at the top level.

- FROM (measured on this branch's pins before the fix): `409 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"CONCURRENT_UPDATE","message":"Record task/ID was modified by another user (current version T1, expected T0)"}}`
- TO: the same, plus `"details":{"currentVersion":"T1"}`

Status, `code` and `message` do not move. A throw that is not a `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE` renders byte-identically to before. The REST door's answer is unchanged.

**Both doors pick the change up from `adapter.ts` alone:** `createHonoApp`'s `thrownJson` (`packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`, not edited here), `wrap()` through `runHandler`, the `onError` seam, and the metrics observer's status read all call `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`.

## `currentRecord` is held on these doors (#23586)

The protocol reads the conflict's current row with `probeRecord`, which is `engine.findOne(object, { where: { id }, context: { isSystem: true } })` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`). `assertVersionOf` throws that row as `currentRecord` before `engine.update` / `engine.delete` apply the caller's write policy, and no layer narrows it. So the field may carry a row, or fields, that row- or field-level security hides from the caller. That is filed as #23586 (a security exception, not measured at a door). Forwarding it here would widen that possible disclosure to two more doors.

A version token carries no row data, so `currentVersion` lands now. `declaredConflictContext` excludes `currentRecord` by name, with a pointer to #23586 at the exclusion, and the pins assert it ABSENT at both doors. The exclusion is lifted once the producer's answer lands. `RestServer` still forwards the field. That is the producer's question in #23586, and this PR does not touch that door.

## Tests

Final head `69215f8575`.

- **Pins** (both files keep their controls):
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/handler-throw-declared-envelope.test.ts`, the `[#23531]` block. A direct-mount `PATCH` and `DELETE` route judges `If-Match` and throws a `ConcurrentUpdateError`-shaped refusal that states both fields. The pins assert `error.details` equals `{ currentVersion }` exactly, that it has no `currentRecord`, and that the row's values appear nowhere in the body.
  - `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-declared-envelope.conformance.test.ts`, the `[#23531]` block. A real `createHonoApp` over the real dispatcher and protocol (SQLite WASM), with stale `If-Match` on `PATCH` and `DELETE`. `currentVersion` is proved by use: echoed as the next `If-Match`, it is accepted (`PATCH` writes, `DELETE` deletes). `currentRecord` is asserted absent, although the real protocol states it (round 0 read it on this rig as `{ id, name }`).
- **Red before the fix** (round 0, pins only, `13b5267b42`): unit `Tests 2 failed | 21 passed (23)`, conformance `Tests 2 failed | 13 passed (15)`. The body then had no `details`.
- **Ablation, round 1**, on `69215f8575`:
  - Method: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, plus an outer `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restore against the absolute path. Each leg was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` showed the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`.
  - **Leg A** dropped the exclusion: anchor ``&& key !== 'currentRecord'),`` became a key no body carries. The absence pins went RED, unit `2 failed | 21 passed` (`expected { …(2) } to deeply equal { Object (currentVersion) }`) and conformance `2 failed | 13 passed` (`to not have property "currentRecord"`).
  - **Leg B** disabled the guard: anchor ``if (resolved.code !== 'CONCURRENT_UPDATE') return undefined;`` was made unmatchable. The `currentVersion` pins went RED, unit `2 failed | 21 passed` (`expected undefined to deeply equal …`) and conformance `2 failed | 13 passed` (`expected 'undefined' to be 'string'`).
  - On a first run, leg B's conformance red came from a `TypeError` instead: the absence assertion ran on an undefined `details` before the `currentVersion` check. The assertions were reordered (`69215f8575`) and both legs re-run, with the result above.
  - **Restore:** blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean. After a rebuild, preflight `--absent` found both markers gone from all 6 built files. Both suites were green again.
- **Packages** at `69215f8575`:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server typecheck` (tsc, `tsconfig.typecheck.json`, and `check:test-typecheck` OK with 0 debt) and `test`: `Test Files 29 passed`, `Tests 340 passed`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/http-conformance typecheck` (`check:test-typecheck` OK, ledger unchanged) and `vitest run`: `Test Files 13 passed`, `Tests 139 passed`.
  - Both ran after a rebuild of `http-conformance`'s dependency closure, `plugin-hono-server` included.
- `@objectstack/hono`'s own suite is not run locally: its vitest config stubs `@objectstack/runtime`, its source is untouched, and the composed-host pin above covers its behaviour. It is declared to CI.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` was clean at the start of the round (one docs commit ahead), so the branch was not merged again. The round-0 merge (`9d467b933a`) stands.

- `--ran` reconciliation: `66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a derived zero; every line carries its exit code).

- Lint: `pnpm lint` is the repo-level scan CI owns (`Lint · ESLint`). Narrowed locally to the three changed sources with the same flags (`eslint --no-inline-config`): exit 0, with 0 errors and 0 warnings each. The ESLint config is unchanged between the merge base and `origin/main`.
- Every family CI runs on this PR is CI's to report on its check-runs.

## Changeset

`.changeset/23531-hono-conflict-body.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` `patch` and `@objectstack/hono` `patch`. The TO body is `details.currentVersion` only, and one sentence says `currentRecord` is held until #23586 and that the REST door's answer is unchanged. `@objectstack/hono` is named because `createHonoApp`'s answer is the measured door, and its CHANGELOG carries the #23365 entry that states this gap. Nothing in its own files changes, and both packages are in the one fixed version group, so naming it moves no version.

## Acceptance notes

- **#23586:** `currentRecord` is a system-context row, thrown before the caller's write policy runs. It is held on these two doors until the producer's answer lands, and this card's `currentRecord` half is ordered after it.
- **#23587:** the same family, beyond this card. A real `createHonoApp` answered a restricted `DELETE` with `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED` and without the `developerMessage`, `dependentObject`, `dependentCount` and `object` that `RestServer`'s arm carries (measured at `d7484b8621`). Not measured: `METADATA_CONFLICT`'s `currentVersion`, and the engine's `INVALID_FIELD`. Widening `declaredConflictContext` from one code to "the arm agrees on status and code" is the mechanical shape.
- `object` is not forwarded: `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` has no route context, so the arm is asked without one, and the arm adds `object` only when given one.
- The adapter-side file surface is `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`, the helper beside it, and one added name on the existing `@objectstack/types` import. No new export.
